fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and local commentary on Miami civic affairs, including opposition to recalling city commissioners and discussion of political campaigns and labor vote-buying allegations. Coverage includes the Miami Chamber of Commerce parade and disputes over hiring local versus outside musicians for park performances, notes on Bayfront Park and Bayshore Park bandstands, and commentary on tourism and hospitality during the 1927–1928 winter season. Additional pieces address school coeducation concerns, proposed post office site and a union station alternative, consumer price issues (e.g., strawberries), and extensive local advertising and political notices connected to upcoming elections and the Shrine convention.
